recent_commits.message: v1.0.30: Trackpad remapping, Bridge dialog, focus rules, PC fix dialog
Accessibility row shows PC fix dialog with short URL and steps
Remove broken Fix on TV button from Accessibility status row
Fix cut-off pairing steps text: smaller size, tighter spacing
Add visual focus highlight to status rows so D-pad selection is visible
Fix D-pad navigation: status rows always focusable, not only when showing X
Fix publish race: pull --rebase before push to updates repo
Fix unresolved references: statusRow returns View, capture bridgeRow/a11yRow for focus
Remove old permission card referencing non-existent R.color.text
Fix nullability: ctx must be non-null for wakeScreenDirect
Fix nullable lambda capture in statusRow
Fix Kotlin type error in POWER dispatch

tasks.label: 1.0.26 published: AirPlay home screen, tappable status rows
Fixed: D-pad navigation was completely broken when statuses showed checkmarks
Trackpad remapping: center-halfway=1, near-edge=2, flick=5 (waiting for Tyson to finish testing)
Bug: Bridge status row doesn't refresh after tapping Start (shows X even when running)
UX: Bridge row should show a dialog when tapped (e.g., 'Looking for iPhone to pair...') instead of just silently starting
Bug: Settings cog and other top elements have no focus highlight (can't tell what's selected)
UX: ONN 4K Pro must never be focusable. Status rows only focusable when showing X (need action). When all checkmarks, only Settings cog is selectable.
App: Circular progress ring animation when downloading/installing update (same Apple-style as website)
App: Badge on Settings cog when update is available (red dot indicator)
App: Notification when update is available (if auto-check finds one)
Bug v1.0.29: D-pad navigation jumps around erratically when clicking in Settings/app
UX: Accessibility status should auto-update to checkmark live when service connects, without requiring app restart
App: Help note on home screen - 'If iPhone won't connect, try restarting your iPhone'

version_history.notes: First working build: iPhone keyboard text entry, push-to-talk voice on TV mics, Android 14 crash fix, in-app updater, trackpad tuning, Gemini assist
Apple TV-style UI refresh, updates moved to Settings, PC setup wizard page, large-text toggle option
Onboarding walkthrough with animated checklist for first-time setup
Auto-start on TV boot, automatic update check on launch, Wi-Fi network hint, built-in remote control guide
PC setup page can now enable accessibility directly via ADB commands
Apple TV trackpad feel improvements, keyboard reappears reliably on reconnect, power button can wake the TV
TV stays reachable during sleep so the iPhone power button can wake it
PC setup ADB command now preserves other accessibility services instead of replacing them
AirPlay-style home screen, tappable status rows with D-pad navigation fix
Visual focus highlight for D-pad, fixed cut-off pairing steps text

changes: Visual focus highlight: D-pad selection now shows a white background on status rows so you can see what's selected
Fixed cut-off pairing steps text: smaller size and tighter spacing so all 4 steps are visible
Settings cog now highlights when focused via D-pad
